:::{#thm-conditional-entropy-average}
#### Conditional entropy as an average of entropies given a value

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-surprisal,

$$\entropyf{Y \mid X} = \sum_{x} p(x) \, \entropyf{Y \mid X=x},$$

where $p(x) \eqdef \P(X=x)$,
and the sum runs over the values $x$ with $p(x) > 0$.

:::

::: {.proof}

The [law of iterated expectations](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#thm-lie)
conditions on $X$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{Y \mid X}
&= \E{\surprisalf{Y \mid X}} \\
&= \E{\condE{\surprisalf{Y \mid X}}{X}} \\
&= \sum_{x} p(x) \, \condE{\surprisalf{Y \mid x}}{X=x} \\
&= \sum_{x} p(x) \, \entropyf{Y \mid X=x}.
\end{aligned}
$$

The first line is @def-conditional-entropy,
the third line is the [definition of expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) over the values $x$ of $X$,
and the last line is @def-entropy-given-value.

:::
